_readme: All site copy lives here. Edit and run `node build.mjs`. Structure mirrors the reference site: numbered sections 01-06 down a left spine, alternating dark and light.

meta.title: Infinity Development — IT solutions, software, cloud and AI
meta.description: Infinity Development — an international IT solutions company covering server software, artificial intelligence, branding and marketing, web development, IoT and UI/UX design. Contact info@infdev.dev.

hero.headline: Your digital future, without limits
hero.body: Infinity Development is an international company in the field of IT solutions. We cover the complete spectrum of the sector — server software solutions, artificial intelligence, branding and marketing, web development, Internet of Things (IoT) and UI/UX design — delivered by one engineering team, under one contract.
hero.photo: Wide shot of the team at work — open-plan office, screens lit, shallow depth of field. Dark enough to carry white type across the upper half.

services.label: Our services
services.headline: Transforming ideas into working systems
services.intro: At Infinity Development we redefine what technology can do for your business. With a focus on innovation and a commitment to excellence, we bring modern solutions to companies of every size.

items.title: Custom Software Development
items.body: Bespoke software built around your business — platforms, integrations and tools that fit the way you actually work.
items.photo: Close crop of hands on a keyboard, warm desk light, code out of focus behind.

items.title: Cloud Solutions & Services
items.body: Cloud architecture that scales with demand, streamlines operations and keeps infrastructure costs under control.
items.photo: Data centre corridor, racks receding, cool blue-green lighting.

items.title: Cybersecurity & Risk Management
items.body: Protect your data and operations with security designed in from the start — hardening, monitoring and rapid response.
items.photo: Macro of a circuit board, teal traces catching the light.

items.title: AI Integration & Machine Learning
items.body: Put artificial intelligence to work in your business — automation, prediction and insight where they pay off most.
items.photo: Abstract neural or particle visual, teal on black.

items.title: IT Support & Managed Services
items.body: Proactive support and system care that keeps your operations stable, patched and running around the clock.
items.photo: Operations desk, multiple monitors with dashboards, engineer silhouetted.

items.title: Tailored Solutions
items.body: Every solution is crafted to fit your business — never a template, never one-size-fits-all.

items.title: Cutting-Edge Technology
items.body: Modern tools chosen for longevity and support, so what we build stays current and maintainable.

items.title: Proven Expertise
items.body: A seasoned team with a wide range of skills — and one accountable point of contact from start to finish.

items.title: Security You Can Trust
items.body: Robust measures that protect your data and operations against evolving threats.

items.title: Seamless Integration
items.body: New technology introduced alongside what you already run — without disrupting your business.

items.title: Cloud Optimisation
items.body: Infrastructure sized deliberately, so you pay for the capacity you use — and scale when you need to.

items.title: Agile Development
items.body: From custom applications to enterprise systems, delivered in increments you can see and use.

items.title: Unmatched Support
items.body: Support that actually answers — monitoring, maintenance and real responses at any hour.

items.title: Server Software Solutions
items.body: Server-side systems engineered for your workload — APIs, data layers and platforms built to scale.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence
items.body: AI that changes how your business runs — automating the repetitive and supporting smarter decisions.

items.title: Brand & Marketing
items.body: A brand identity with real presence, and the campaigns that carry it to market.

items.title: Web Development
items.body: Fast, accessible websites and web applications that give your business a serious online presence.

items.title: Internet of Things (IoT)
items.body: Connected devices that unlock smarter, more efficient operations — from a handful of sensors to a full fleet.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.body: Intuitive, engaging interfaces backed by research — experiences your users will actually enjoy.

design.label: Design and Marketing Services
design.headline: Design & Marketing
design.intro: Our experts share practical insight on building a unique brand, impressive websites and advertising campaigns that reach the right audience. Let's build a strong image for your business, together.

cards.title: Product research
cards.photo: Desk scene — laptop and monitor showing analytics, natural window light, muted tones.

cards.title: Strategy development
cards.photo: Hands at a wall of sticky notes, workshop in progress, backlit.

cards.title: Design solutions
cards.photo: Colour swatch books and printed palette sheets fanned across a dark surface.

cards.title: Marketing launch
cards.photo: Wide shot — team presenting to clients in a bright meeting room. Full-bleed banner crop.

contact.label: Contact us
contact.headline: Let's connect
contact.body: Tell us what you need built and we'll come back with questions, a plan, and an honest view on fit. Reach us any time at info@infdev.dev.

footer.blurb: An IT company delivering server software, cloud, artificial intelligence, web development, IoT and UI/UX design.

notes.photos: The imagery is original generated abstract art in the brand palette. To use real photography instead, overwrite the matching file in assets/img/ (keep the filename) and rebuild; the shot briefs for a future photoshoot are kept on each item's 'photo' field in this file.
notes.content: No invented clients, testimonials or statistics appear anywhere on this site.
